options.text: Run the gates and push as the branch stands. Step 4's fail-first rule is about the defect's fix, every reproduction already has a case seen to fail, and the EVENT_NAME fallback was only a side effect of that fix.

Before the gates and the push, write selftest cases that hold where the gate takes EVENT_NAME from (step env, then job env, then workflow env), and see each one fail against a copy of the gate without that fallback.
Push as the branch stands, say in the pull request's body that the EVENT_NAME fallback has no case yet, and file a follow-up issue to add its cases.
